elements.label: Necessities
elements.description: Mundane Tools, Ammunition, Medical Supplies, Food — war shattered the currency of the Wake, yet forged a replacement of such startling efficiency that few can deny its worth.

elements.label: Trace
elements.description:
Malevolent attention from a rival.

[The more traces remain, the greater the chance your enemies will appear each season.]

slots.label: More?
slots.description: More Distractions — I can put in some personal effort as well.

elements.label: A Failure
elements.description: I must cast aside all that has made me fail.

elements.label: Eye-Burning Blood
elements.description: My lineage is profoundly rare, and its past standing could be called exalted even across the Mansus; thus, I endure and am potent enough to reshape. [A superior form of Health.]

elements.label: Gift from Glory
elements.description: I understand the Glory far better than most of the immortals—though that is no cause for pride, for my own kindred are born from it. [A superior form of Reason.]

slots.label: Target
slots.description: Place a Hidden Enemy to reveal it, or place an Domicile for rapid searching.

elements.label: Infinite Yearning
elements.description: One truth often overlooked is that desire does not diminish, even at the heights of the Mansus. Thus I yearn—for ease and pleasure, to become what I should not be. [A superior form of Passion.]

elements.label: Eye-Burning Blood (Exhausted)
elements.description: No matter the injury or fatigue, an immortal regains strength swiftly—unless the harm done was truly grievous.

elements.label: Gift from Glory (Exhausted)
elements.description: No matter the injury or fatigue, an immortal regains strength swiftly—unless the harm done was truly grievous.

elements.label: Infinite Yearning (Exhausted)
elements.description: No matter the injury or fatigue, an immortal regains strength swiftly—unless the harm done was truly grievous.

elements.label: Eye-Burning Blood (Recovering)
elements.description: Just a temporary setback—it will soon be restored as new. [This card will recover after a set period of time, or you may use specific cards to accelerate this process.]

slots.label: Vitality
slots.description: The power that helps with recovery.

elements.label: Infinite Yearning (Recovering)

slots.description: The power that helps with recovery.

elements.description: Just a temporary setback—it will soon be restored as new. [This card will recover after a set period of time, or you may use specific cards to accelerate this process.]

slots.label: Light
slots.description: The power that helps with recovery.

elements.label: My Wound
elements.description: The flesh sizzles, light seething from within. [Will heal once the duration ends; you may also use a Strength to hasten the process.]

elements.label: My Unhealing Wound
elements.description: A permanent flaw, a prolonged torment. [This card can only be restored in specific locations.]

elements.label: Eye-Burning Blood (Damaged)
elements.description: Violent trauma, scars, and withered powers.

elements.label: Gift from Glory (Damaged)
elements.description: Dim as the lamps of black nephrite in Nowhere.

elements.label: Infinite Yearning (Damaged)
elements.description: Aimless, unyielding passion.

elements.label: Arrival of the Chandler
elements.description: I now dwell as the Chandler's Name, at the cost that I must find a path to become their vessel and bring about their birth. When that time comes, I shall become them, or they will replace me. The former is undoubtedly a delight, the latter rather… less so.

elements.label: Ascension: The Chandler
elements.description:
The flame of the Chandler burns fiercely within me, more intensely than ever before. I can sense its desperate desire to break free, for I am also constantly longing for that perfect moment to arrive. Faster, faster.
[This desire cannot be changed, but it is also the key to victory. When you reach your destined place, place it into the 'Work' to obtain hints.]

elements.label: Revolution of Steel
elements.description: Winning the Second Dawn myself: A dangerous and life-threatening idea, but enticing enough and innovative enough. I need far greater power than I have now to realize it - perhaps even going beyond the limits of my own imagination would not be sufficient.

elements.label: Ascension: Revolution of Steel
elements.description:
The touch of Glory kindled the spark of change within me. Now, I am constantly yearning for transformation and conquest - this desire extends not only to the entire world but also to my own existence.
[This desire cannot be changed, but it is also the key to victory. When you reach your destined place, place it into the 'Work' to obtain hints.]

elements.label: The Returning of Noon
elements.description: I remember a simpler and brighter time. If fate turns in the right direction, perhaps I can bring back the Sun of the past and eventually recreate those days.

elements.label: Asecnsion: The Returning of Noon
elements.description:
The light of the memories from the past is brighter than ever before, and I have been permanently transformed by it. I know what must be done, and I accept the sacrifice that is certain to come.
[This desire cannot be changed, but it is also the key to victory. When you reach your destined place, place it into the 'Work' to obtain hints.]

elements.label: A Vague Afterglow
elements.description:
A dilapidated memory from the noon era gives a strange sense of familiarity somehow. I need more light to fully restore its content.
[Use this in the Sun Shrine to advance the game process.]

elements.label: A Vague Afterglow
elements.description:
From the memories of the undivided sun, the truth of the noon era is inscribed. I need more light to restore its content.
[Use this in the Sun Shrine to advance the game process.]

elements.label: A Vague Afterglow
elements.description:
From the memory of the undivided sun, there is engraved the mystery of the returning of the noon. I need more light to restore its content.
[Use this in the Sun Shrine to advance the game process.]

elements.label: Final Resolve
elements.description:
Necessary pain and sacrifice.
[At a specific location, show this card to a specific target - at that moment, your fate will be changed.]

elements.label: Red Flower
elements.description:
'At the right time and in the right place, burn this beautiful flower. Then the Mare will bring you a little convenience as promised. But, if you waste it carelessly, she will be glad to see you in a panic over it... Do you understand? Then, wish you a smooth journey.'
[When all the conditions are ready, use this item in the destined place - at that time, your fate will be changed.]

elements.label: Dusk Essense
elements.description: The most concise essence of a Madrugad's Name, within lies a profound and enduring power of balancing.

elements.label: Numen: a Merciless Alteration
elements.description: The fundamental flaw; the irresistible shortcut; the hate that heats; the change that mars; the scar that opens...These are the most despicable and filthy chapters of history, and I can exploit their potential.

elements.label: Numen: the Paths of the Sun
elements.description: The Sun has charted his Paths - paths beyond walls and woods and Bounds. When we are ready, all of us will enter Eternity- at least, in the right History...

elements.label: Numen: the Bells of Ys
elements.description: Ys, by her arts, found the strike-tone that shakes the Hours. A bell cast with this secret could speak the Ys-note...

elements.label: Numen: Loopholes
elements.description: When Eternity came into the world, certain prudent powers arranged loopholes. Those loopholes may open again...

elements.label: Searing Enigma
elements.description: An ancient and intricate grand plan, merely recalling its details would ignite the mind. Its age is even older than the Grail and the Moth. And its realm far surpasses the level that words can convey.

elements.label: Celia's guidance
elements.description: Celia has already pleaded with the Sun-in-Rags on my behalf and pointed out the route from the border to where he is located.

elements.label: Wane
elements.description: Without this, beauty and truth could have coexisted.

elements.label: Shattered Crown
elements.description:
A cruel gift bestowed by the god which is not as it was. The flesh and blood are cold and lifeless like ice, the soul is shattered and filled with grief, yet the end is never so distant - it is beyond reach.

[With this card present, you will be able to withstand up to seven wounds instead of three.]

elements.label: THE WOUND
elements.description:
'CAPUT GERAT LUPINUM.'
The Sun was divided, and this is its wound.
[This counts as six wounds.]
